- .claude/scripts/loaded_settings_check.py:140-142 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The FileNotFoundError handler returns the generic reason "no record for this session: the settings load recorder hook has not run" without checking result["before_recorder_wired"]. The UNOBSERVABLE_REASON selection at lines 157-158 is unreachable when no record exists, which is the canonical pre-recorder case.
  WHY: A pre-recorder branch has no ConfigChange recorder, so the sync merge's reload is never recorded. The check reaches FileNotFoundError at line 140 and returns the generic reason at line 142. The before_recorder_wired field is set at line 135 but never consulted on this path. The operator and the escalation blocker receive "no record for this session" instead of the cause-specific reason that names the pre-recorder branch and guides the operator to confirm merged wiring and push the sync merge. The twin at workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/loaded_settings_check.py:146-150 already has the correct fix: if result["before_recorder_wired"] is False: result["reason"] = UNOBSERVABLE_REASON.
- .claude/scripts/loaded_settings_check.py:112 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The except clause catches (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) but does not include ValueError. subprocess.run(text=True) at line 108 can raise UnicodeDecodeError (a subclass of ValueError) when git show produces invalid UTF-8 output.
  WHY: recorder_wired_at is called during result dict construction at line 130. An undecodable git show output causes recorder_wired_at to raise UnicodeDecodeError, crashing the check before it prints any JSON verdict. The caller receives a Python traceback instead of a structured one-line verdict with exit code. The twin at line 116 already has except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError, ValueError).
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:185 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Step 4 still says "Push it with the push the caller already uses." The fix text should be "Do not push it on its own: the caller's own push carries it, and never before step 6 below has confirmed the settings when the merge changed .claude/settings.json (a Settings restart pushes nothing)."
  WHY: If a sync merge changes .claude/settings.json, step 4 instructs the session to push the merge immediately, before step 6s settings check runs. When the check fails and the Settings restart path activates, the merge is already on the remote branch under unconfirmed guard wiring. The contradiction between step 4s push instruction and Settings restart item 1 ("The sync merge stays local and unpushed") means the fail-closed intent is not preserved. The twin at workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:185 already has the corrected text.
